decisions.reason: Although framed as building on the offer, a superfood consumer product is relatively distant from the firm's strongest absorptive base in industrial waste-to-value technologies, so learning and improvement are less efficient than in its core plant businesses.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions sit squarely in the firm's engineering and decentralized energy knowledge base, and the multi-model line gives good scope to absorb customer feedback and refine the offer.

As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy system directly rooted in the firm's core R&D and research-cooperation capabilities, it is exactly the kind of product the firm is well placed to interpret, improve and commercialize.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is close to the firm's existing waste-conversion platform and strategic direction, so despite technical and market uncertainty its absorptive capacity supports continued development rather than withdrawal.
